items.name: infinite-gallery
items.title: Infinite Gallery
items.description: A 3D gallery that endlessly scrolls through textured planes with cloth-like distortion and scroll-driven transitions.

usage.label: Astro
usage.code:
---
import "@/components/motion-kit/infinite-gallery-element.ts";
---

<motion-infinite-gallery
  images='[{"src":"/1.jpg","alt":"One"},{"src":"/2.jpg","alt":"Two"}]'
  speed="1"
  visible-count="8"
  class="h-[600px] w-full"
></motion-infinite-gallery>

usage.label: React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "`@/components/motion-kit/infinite-gallery-element.ts`";
</script>

<template>
  <motion-infinite-gallery
    :images='JSON.stringify([{"src":"/1.jpg","alt":"One"},{"src":"/2.jpg","alt":"Two"}])'
    speed="1"
    visible-count="8"
    class="h-[600px] w-full"
  />
</template>

usage.label: Svelte
usage.code:
<script>
  import "@/components/motion-kit/infinite-gallery-element.ts";
</script>

<motion-infinite-gallery
  images='[{"src":"/1.jpg","alt":"One"},{"src":"/2.jpg","alt":"Two"}]'
  speed="1"
  visible-count="8"
  class="h-[600px] w-full"
/>

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-kit/infinite-gallery-element.js"></script>

<motion-infinite-gallery
  images='[{"src":"/1.jpg","alt":"One"},{"src":"/2.jpg","alt":"Two"}]'
  speed="1"
  visible-count="8"
  class="h-[600px] w-full"
></motion-infinite-gallery>

props.name: images
props.description: JSON-serialized array of image URLs or objects with src and optional alt properties.

props.name: speed
props.description: Scroll speed multiplier.

props.name: visible-count
props.description: Number of image planes visible at once.

props.name: fade-settings
props.description: Fade transition zones (normalized 0-1).

props.name: blur-settings
props.description: Blur transition zones and maximum blur amount.

items.name: infinite-physics-gallery
items.title: Infinite Physics Gallery
items.description: Infinite 2-D draggable grid with physics-based momentum, edge scrolling, and support for mixed image/video cells. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

usage.label: Astro
usage.code:
---
import "@/components/motion-kit/infinite-physics-gallery-element.ts";
---

<motion-infinite-physics-gallery
  items='[{"type":"image","src":"/1.jpg"},{"type":"image","src":"/2.jpg"}]'
  cell-width="320"
  cell-height="400"
  class="h-[480px] w-full rounded-2xl overflow-hidden"
></motion-infinite-physics-gallery>

props.name: items
props.description: JSON array of media items: [{type:"image|video",src:"...",alt:"..."}].

props.name: cell-width
props.description: Cell width in pixels.

props.name: cell-height
props.description: Cell height in pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between cells in pixels.

props.name: friction
props.description: Base inertia friction (0–1).

props.name: wheel-speed
props.description: Wheel speed multiplier.

props.name: edge-threshold
props.description: Edge auto-scroll threshold in pixels.

props.name: edge-scroll-speed
props.description: Edge auto-scroll speed.

items.name: radial-gallery
items.title: Radial Gallery
items.description: Circular rotating image gallery. Items are evenly spaced around a ring that spins continuously. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

usage.label: Astro
usage.code:
---
import "@/components/motion-kit/radial-gallery-element.ts";
---

<motion-radial-gallery
  items='[{"src":"/img/1.jpg"},{"src":"/img/2.jpg"}]'
  radius="480"
  duration="24"
  element-size="160"
  class="h-[360px] w-full overflow-hidden"
></motion-radial-gallery>

props.name: items
props.description: JSON array of image objects with src and alt properties.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the circle in pixels.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of one full rotation in seconds.

props.name: reversed
props.description: Rotate counter-clockwise.

props.name: offset
props.description: Extra pixels to offset the ring center below the visible area.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between items in pixels.

props.name: element-size
props.description: Estimated item width in pixels for circumference calculations.

items.name: video-player

props.description: URL of the video file to play.

props.name: poster

props.name: hide-controls
